# Findings

Verified research results, per faction. Human-readable summaries with engine data backing.

**Committed build output.** `data/merged/` and `findings/` are regenerated by
`scripts/gen_findings_html.py` and `scripts/army_advisor.py`, and
`scripts/check_artifacts_current.py` fails CI when a tracked file drifts from a
fresh regeneration. Do not hand-edit anything in here.

## Structure

```
findings/
  index.html              landing page — army tier list + per-faction cards
  advisor.json            army-level meta indices (28 factions)
  army_tiers.json         rules-free per-mission scores (28 factions)
  <faction>/
    findings.html         the report
    data.json             machine-readable sidecar the MCP server reads
    <topic>.html          optional one-off analysis (e.g. dark-angels/take-and-hold-trivector.html)
```

## Served by the MCP server

| Tool | Reads |
|------|-------|
| `get_findings` | `<faction>/data.json` — per-unit competition table, all 5 missions |
| `get_army_index` | `advisor.json` — overall/ceiling/floor/versatility/first-army fit |
| `get_faction_tiers` | `army_tiers.json` — factions ranked by one mission |
| `compare_factions` | both of the above, side by side |
| `list_findings_topics` | filenames only, including one-off `<topic>.html` reports |

### Why the sidecar exists

`data.json` is written by the same generator pass that writes `findings.html`,
projecting only the fields `get_findings` renders. It used to be read by
regexing a `const DATA = {...}` blob out of the HTML, which tied a data tool to
the report's markup — any restyle of the page silently broke the tool. The HTML
is presentation; `data.json` is the data.

Both artifacts are regenerated together, so they cannot drift. If you add a
field the tool needs, add it to `MCP_FINDINGS_FIELDS` in
`scripts/gen_findings_html.py` — the sidecar is a projection, not a second
computation.

## Standards

- Every finding must cite engine data or explicit reasoning
- No speculation marked as fact — use `🟢 FACTS`, `🟡 USE CASES`, `🟠 CONSTRAINTS`, `🔴 STRATEGY` tiers
- Include an assumption registry
- Pass Shredder review before committing
